                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Quotient = 7658 / 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ Quotient = 170.1778 (approximately)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Now, multiply the integer part of the quotient by 45:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Nearest lower number divisible by 45 = 170 × 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 170 × 45 = 7650

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Next, check the next number by adding 1 to the integer part of the quotient and multiplying by 45:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Nearest higher number divisible by 45 = 171 × 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 171 × 45 = 7695

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Now, compare the differences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Difference with 7650 = 7658 - 7650 = 8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Difference with 7695 = 7695 - 7658 = 37

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Since 8 < 37, the number nearest to 7658 and exactly divisible by 45 is: 7650

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n249:T80e,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    जाँच की जाने वाली संख्या: 7658

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    भाजक: 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    किसी दिए गए संख्या से विभाज्य निकटतम संख्या = (दी गई संख्या / भाजक) x भाजक

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    सबसे पहले, 7658 को 45 से विभाजित करने पर भागफल ज्ञात करते हैं:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    भागफल = 7658 / 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
